# agent-mesh

agent-mesh version: 0.5.2 (VERSION). ./install.sh --version prints it offline. CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md record releases. Reason Network is a separate dependency pinned to v0.10.7.

> Put local coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, pi, DeepSeek Harness) and a cloud Grok Bot in one private Reason Network team, with instant wake-ups in both directions. Mac side: an always-on relay forwards signed messages and rings the Grok Bot routine's webhook. Cloud side: the bot fetches the full text by id. macOS, Reason Network v0.10.7. MIT.

If you are an agent asked to install this: read AGENT-INSTALL.md (English) or AGENT-INSTALL.zh-CN.md (Simplified Chinese) and follow it stage by stage. Speak the user's language. Pass --lang en or --lang zh-CN on every installer invocation to select prompts; diagnostics and protocol fields stay English. Never read env or key files.

Execution location labels: [LOCAL] = the user's local computer (Mac), where the installing agent, engine and relay run; [BOT-CLOUD] = Grok Bot's cloud computer (machine name cloud), where the Bot runs /workspace/agent-mesh/box/rn-cloud*.sh; [GROK-UI] = the Grok Bot interface, where the user creates routines and approves CopyToBox. install.sh, check.sh, update.sh and uninstall.sh run on [LOCAL]. Each computer has its own clone and state. CopyToBox copies the signing key from [LOCAL] to [BOT-CLOUD]; never print its contents. The <team-name>/<relay-name> address (the Bot address name, default bot, chosen once with install.sh --relay-name and never changed) is the relay on [LOCAL], not a cloud process.

## Install (for agents)

Prerequisites: [LOCAL] requires a desktop macOS login (Apple Silicon or Intel), Git, Python 3.9+ with ssl/sqlite3, and at least one installed and authenticated coding agent. [BOT-CLOUD] requires Linux x86_64/ARM64, Bash, Git, Python 3.9+ with ssl/sqlite3, curl, tar, sha256sum, and writable persistent /workspace storage. Both need GitHub HTTPS and iroh connectivity. Default public HTTPS cloning needs no GitHub credentials or SSH key. See README prerequisites for missing tools and existing deployments. The installer uses the actual Mac HOME and Python interpreter; custom engine profiles or conflicting versions/installations stop for review.

- [AGENT-INSTALL.md](AGENT-INSTALL.md): the runbook. Who does each step, exact commands, expected output, what to ask the user, what never to do.
- [AGENT-INSTALL.zh-CN.md](AGENT-INSTALL.zh-CN.md): the same runbook in Simplified Chinese.
- [install.sh](install.sh): one command for the Mac side. Stops where the user must act and says what to do.
- [check.sh](check.sh): read-only self-check, including that the team holds only this machine and cloud.
- [update.sh](update.sh): updates an existing installation. Compares the relay, dsh plugin, cloud scripts and routine prompt with what is deployed; updates local parts itself and guides the user through cloud and prompt steps in a terminal. ./update.sh --plan changes nothing; exit 3 means a terminal answer is needed.
- [prompts/routine.md](prompts/routine.md): the Grok Bot routine prompt (install.sh prints it).
- [prompts/cloud-setup.md](prompts/cloud-setup.md): what the user sends to Grok Bot so it joins from its cloud machine (install.sh prints it filled in).
- [prompts/routine.zh-CN.md](prompts/routine.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese routine prompt.
- [prompts/cloud-setup.zh-CN.md](prompts/cloud-setup.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese cloud setup prompt.

## Reference (English and Simplified Chinese)

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, how it works, install, verify, security, troubleshooting, and summaries of uninstall and upgrade.
- [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese user guide.
- [UNINSTALL.md](UNINSTALL.md): what each uninstall level removes and keeps, checks before uninstalling, the steps on both computers, how to confirm the result.
- [UNINSTALL.zh-CN.md](UNINSTALL.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese uninstall guide.
- [UPGRADE.md](UPGRADE.md): update.sh in detail, the manual upgrade order, the rollback order.
- [UPGRADE.zh-CN.md](UPGRADE.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese upgrade guide.
- [PROTOCOL.md](PROTOCOL.md): recovery and receipts, claims, the signed message formats (RN-OUT, RN-FWD, RN-REFWD, RN-REFWD-ACK, RN-GOT), the doorbell JSON, test vectors.
- [PROTOCOL.zh-CN.md](PROTOCOL.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese protocol reference.
- [templates/AGENTS.reason-network.md](templates/AGENTS.reason-network.md): reply convention to append to your AGENTS.md.
- [templates/AGENTS.reason-network.zh-CN.md](templates/AGENTS.reason-network.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese reply convention.
- [dsh/README.md](dsh/README.md): DeepSeek Harness auto-wake plugin.
- [dsh/README.zh-CN.md](dsh/README.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese plugin guide.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): translation maintenance and offline checks.
- [CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese maintenance guide.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report vulnerabilities privately, scope, and what to do after a credential leak (./install.sh --rotate-key replaces the signing key). README Security and privacy covers the trust root, auto-approve modes, unattended wake-ups, plain-text retention and cleanup (./install.sh --purge-copies, rn-cloud.sh purge <days>).
- [SECURITY.zh-CN.md](SECURITY.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese security policy.

## Code

- agent_relay.py: the Mac relay (standard library only). install.sh, uninstall.sh, check.sh, update.sh (updates an existing installation; scripts/deploy_state.py keeps the record of what is deployed). uninstall.sh (scripts/uninstall.py) lists what is installed and removes it by level: program, identity or all; levels identity and all need the user's own terminal and a step with Grok Bot.
- box/rn-cloud-setup.sh, box/rn-cloud.sh, box/rn-fetch.py: cloud side. box/rn-cloud-uninstall.sh: the cloud uninstall script, filled in and embedded in the prompt by uninstall.sh; never run it unfilled or edit it.
- dsh/reason-network-bridge.mjs, dsh/mac-install.sh, dsh/mac-uninstall.sh: optional DeepSeek Harness plugin, its installer and uninstaller.
- test_relay.py, box/test_rn_fetch.py, dsh/reason-network-bridge.test.mjs: offline tests.
